mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_session (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, remembered) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{remembered})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id, u.id AS user_id, s.token_hash, s.expires_at, s.created_at, s.remembered, u.username, u.email FROM auth_session s JOIN app_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at > #{now}
